column1: # Confirmed gcc c-torture/execute miscompiles under +mos-a16 / +mos-xy16, found by the
# Phase 2 full-suite differential run (2026-06-19, -O1) and CONFIRMED in isolation on a
# quiet box with bsnes-jg as an independent second oracle (a16 fails reproduce on BOTH
# MAME and bsnes-jg; xy16 fails reproduce isolated on MAME). The DEFAULT (non-a16) build
# self-checks PASS on every one of these, so each is a real codegen defect, not a
# target-inappropriate test. tools/torture_run.py reads this list and reports a listed
# test as XFAIL instead of FAIL, so the gate stays green-modulo-known (the standard for a
# compiler test suite) while the backlog is triaged + fixed one at a time.
# These are NOT the known register-pressure family (those are build-time crashes/overflows
# matched by a16_fuzz.py KNOWN_ISSUES — regalloc-out-of-registers / scavenger-p-not-gpr /
# a16-zp-pressure-overflow). These are RUNTIME wrong-value miscompiles (a16/xy16 computes a
# wrong result -> the test's own self-check fails -> corpus_result = 0xDEAD).
# Remove a row when its defect is fixed (so the test hard-FAILS again = regression guard).
# === FIXED 2026-06-19: 13 rows cleared by ONE fix ===
# The MOSRegisterInfo::eliminateFrameIndex / CmpBrAbsImm16 frame-index scramble — under
# +mos-a16 LTO, static/zero-page-stack accesses folded into the CmpBrAbsImm16 pseudo
# resolved to base+compareImm instead of base+frameOffset (the displacement was read from
# the wrong operand). Root-caused via 20071210-1, fixed in 0002 (MOSRegisterInfo.cpp). The
# class sweep cleared 13 rows (removed below): 20010518-2, 20020402-1, 20071202-1,
# pr34768-1, pr34768-2. (pr34768-* was mis-filed as an LTO const-attribute bug; 20010518-2
# as a packed-struct/long bug — both were actually this defect.) Regression guard: those
# torture tests now hard-PASS + the always-present examples/65816/a16frameidx micro-test.
# Plan: docs/plans/2026-06-19-321-cmpbrabsimm16-frameindex-elimination-scramble.md
# CAVEAT (oracle gap): "default build self-checks PASS" is necessary but NOT sufficient — a test
# relying on UB our target resolves differently (e.g. 32-bit `int`) can PASS default by chance and
# "fail" a16 as a FALSE POSITIVE. HONORED 2026-06-19: tools/torture_filter.py now denies the
# unsatisfiable integer-width dg-require-effective-targets (int32plus/int128), so such tests are
# SKIP'd as unsupported and never reach this list. (pr7284-1 — `n<<24`, int32plus — was the
# motivating case; it is now filtered out, not listed below.)
# === FIXED 2026-06-20: all 4 remaining xy16 rows cleared by ONE fix ===
# The MOSInsertREPSEP requiredXWidth X-flag (index-width) lattice gap — under +mos-xy16 the
# per-instruction classifier left index-register VALUE ops (the compares CMPImm/CMPImag8/
# CMPAbs reading X/Y, and the register INC/DEC = inx/iny/dex/dey) as X-agnostic (XW_None), so
# each ran in whatever X width was AMBIENT. After a 16-bit-indexed load (rep #$10/#$30) the
# ambient is X=16, so `cpy #imm` read a 2-byte immediate and compared the loop counter's
# UNINITIALIZED high byte (the counter was init/incremented at X=8) -> wrong bound -> hang
# (corpus_result 0x0000) or wrong value. Root-caused via pr49419, fixed in 0002
# (MOSInsertREPSEP.cpp requiredXWidth: classify those ops XW_X8 when the X/Y operand is the
# value). The class sweep cleared ALL FOUR xy16 rows (removed below): pr49419, 20041011-1,
# doloop-1, va-arg-22 — plus k_isort's xy16 leg (dev/run.sh k_isort: all 3 tracks agree).
# Regression guard: those torture tests now hard-PASS (default==+mos-a16==+mos-xy16 on
# MAME + bsnes-jg). Plan: docs/plans/2026-06-19-321-xy16-xflag-lattice-fix.md
# === 2026-06-26: ieee/ fp-cmp-8 "cmove" rows REMOVED — XFAIL was STALE, now positive gates ===
# The ieee/ full-vendoring sweep (5f3b316) recorded 3 xy16 XFAILs for the gcc "cmove patterns"
# body — fp-cmp-8.c + its long-double (fp-cmp-8l.c) and double (pr38016.c) #include-wrappers —
# claiming +mos-xy16 reads 0xDEAD while default/+mos-a16 PASS. INVESTIGATED 2026-06-26: the
# defect does NOT reproduce on a clean build of the committed patch stack (0001..0012). All 3
# XPASS at BOTH -Os and -O1, host==default==+mos-a16==+mos-xy16 on MAME + bsnes-jg; the xy16
# codegen for this body uses NO 16-bit index register at all (no rep/sep #$10, no LDXAbs16), so
# the hypothesized "16-bit index parked in X16 across a select diamond" class cannot manifest.
# The patch stack is byte-identical at the finding commit and HEAD, so the 12:02 sweep measured
# a shared-tree `build/` that did not match the tracked patches (stale/dirty hot-tree) — the same
# stale-XFAIL pattern as pr15296. No compiler change. The 3 tests are now in-scope POSITIVE gates
# (a recurrence hard-FAILs). Plan: docs/plans/2026-06-26-321-xy16-cmove-stale-xfail-resolution.md
